jobs.occupation: Junior Backend Engineer (m/w/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our Data Processing & Analytics Team as a Backend and DevOps Engineer, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Junior Backend Engineer (m/w/d)

In this role, you will help build, maintain, and scale the infrastructure and backend services powering our data analytics platform. You’ll sit at the intersection of backend software development and modern platform operations (DevOps), working closely with data engineers and analysts to ensure our analytics ecosystem is performant, reliable, and observable.

If you enjoy automating deployments, and managing modern data stores in containerized environments, this is a great opportunity to jumpstart your career.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains.

Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as the combat cloud and ground support systems of tomorrow. The way we work together is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, ranging from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. Anyone seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- DevOps Engineering: Contribute to the development and maintenance using Ansible, Gitlab-CI, Helm etc.
- Database Management: Assist in provisioning, configuring, and maintaining operational databases, specifically MongoDB (NoSQL) and InfluxDB (time-series).
- Platform Operations & Containerization: Help manage containerized deployments on Kubernetes(RKE) and deploy applications using Helm charts.
- Observability & Monitoring: Set up and maintain monitoring dashboards and alerting configurations using Prometheus and Grafana to ensure platform uptime and health.
- Version Control & Shell Automation: Use Git for version control and workflow management, and write basic Unix shell scripts (Bash) for automation and routine system tasks.
- Collaboration: Participate in code reviews, document setup procedures, and collaborate with senior platform engineers to troubleshoot infrastructure issues.

Desired skills and qualifications

- An academic degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
- Technical competencies
- Backend Programming: Foundational programming skills in at least one or two core languages used across our ecosystem (Go, Python, Java, or Kotlin).
- Knowledge of DevOps : Ansible, Terraform, Gitlab-CI, Helm, OCI, ArgoCD.
- Version Control: Proficiency with Git (branching, merging, pull requests, versioning workflows).
- Linux / Unix Basics: Working knowledge of Unix/Linux operating systems and comfort navigating the CLI or writing basic shell scripts.
- Problem-Solving Mindset: Eager to learn modern infrastructure practices and systematically debug issues across backend code and data pipelines.
- Soft Skills:
- Strong analytical mindset with a structured approach to problem-solving.
- Ability to work collaboratively within an agile, multicultural team environment.
- Self-motivated, with a proactive attitude toward learning and skill development.
- Nice to have :
- CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or CKAD (Certified Kubernetes Application Developer)
- Language Proficiency:
- English: Professional fluency required
- German: Professional fluency required

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Bid Manager (f/m/d) for Surge Arresters (Ingenieur/in - Energietechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In this role, you are responsible for the efficient and accurate preparation of quotations for the global surge arrester market. Your proposals are based on customer-specific technical requirements, established product solutions, and applicable framework agreements.
You support both internal and external stakeholders by providing timely clarifications and ensuring a high level of customer service throughout the quotation process. In addition, you are responsible for the accurate processing and booking of customer orders, thereby ensuring a seamless transition from sales to execution.
Through your structured, process-oriented approach, you enable regional sales colleagues to further develop business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships. The quality, accuracy, and reliability of your work form the foundation for the efficient execution of downstream operational processes.
You collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization, actively engage with adjacent functions on complex topics, communicate transparently, and contribute to the continuous improvement of existing processes by constructively challenging established ways of working.
Your daily work is supported by SAP, including a powerful integrated configuration tool, as well as the Microsoft Office suite.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Commitment to delivering high customer satisfaction, exceptional service quality, and sustainable business growth
* Active contribution to process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives
* Support and promotion of a collaborative learning culture and knowledge sharing environment
* Customer-centric service excellence and responsiveness to evolving market requirements
* Ownership and accountability for operational effectiveness and business success
* Dedication to advancing the transition toward a CO₂-free and sustainable energy future

What You Bring

* Advanced technical understanding of energy transmission and distribution components and applications
* Strong commitment to professional development, continuous learning, and effective communication
* Rapid comprehension of complex topics and proficiency in utilizing IT tools, including SAP and MS Office
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities within cross-functional and international environments
* Proactive and committed working style, combined with a high level of adaptability and initiative 

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Brand Manager (all genders) (Brand-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Your creative fieldWe are looking for a full-time, permanent Brand Manager (all genders) to start as soon as possible . We live remote-first within Germany , but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.

As our new Brand Manager, you'll have responsibility of one of the most impactful projects currently running at Contabo: our brand. With 250,000+ customers worldwide and a strong reputation in developer and infrastructure communities, we're now transitioning from a VPS-focused positioning toward becoming Europe's AI Cloud Inference Provider.

The groundwork is done: strategy set, agency engaged, direction clear. What we need now is someone who takes ownership of the execution. That means running the agency relationship, driving the messaging architecture for both product identities, and making sure the rollout actually happens - across the website, product UI, API docs, email, paid, social. All of it and consistently.

You'll manage the branding agency end-to-end briefings, feedback rounds, milestone tracking, sign-offs and develop the messaging architecture and tone of voice for both product lines. That includes creating brand guidelines, design tokens, and all the rollout-ready assets that come with it. From there, you drive the actual rollout across every customer-facing touchpoint: website, product UI, API docs, email, paid media, social.

You brief and quality-control content output from internal and external contributors, keep the PR story pipeline moving together with our PR Manager, and set up brand tracking across Peec.ai, GA4, sentiment, and Share of Voice - reporting results directly to the Head of Creative Marketing and the CMO. As we continue to expand into EU, US, and LATAM markets, you're also the one making sure brand consistency and localization stay on track.

You'll report directly to the Head of Creative Marketing in the CMO organization and work closely with Product, Support, SEO/GAIO, and PR - without having direct authority over those teams. Strong stakeholder management is therefore a core part of making this work.

What convinces usYour personality, paired with:

Must have:
• Proven experience developing brand strategy and identity - verbal and visual - from brief through to delivery
• Track record managing external agency relationships end-to-end (briefings, feedback rounds, sign-offs)
• Real familiarity with B2B / B2C tech audiences, particularly developers and infrastructure engineers - not surface-level, but you know how they think and what they dismiss immediately
• Project management across cross-functional teams: milestone tracking, stakeholder alignment, the coordination that doesn't show up in the final deck but determines whether the final deck ever gets implemented
• 5+ years in brand management or brand strategy, with meaningful time in B2B tech, SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or developer-focused products
• English C1/C2 (working language) and German B2+, other EU languages are a plus

Should have:
• Experience with brand tracking and measurement – sentiment, Share of Voice, brand recall surveys; you've used data to make a concrete decision, not just reported it
• Hands-on with tools like Peec.ai or Brand24, GA4, Figma, Confluence/Jira, and at least one CMS
• AI usage fluency

Nice to have:
• SEO and content strategy fundamentals; understanding of GAIO/LLM visibility is a real advantage here
• Experience in a PE-backed or VC-backed environment where ownership is high and process guardrails are limited
• Spanish or Portuguese

jobs.occupation: Director, Solutions Engineering (SAP Hana performance) (Relationship-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an SAP HANA Performance Team Leader to plan, execute, and validate the performance of SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV and AOS. This role is responsible for qualifying our software to meet SAP benchmark targets and certifying third-party OEM servers for inclusion in SAP’s certified hardware directory.

About the Team

Nutanix's Solutions & Performance Engineering team is a globally distributed organization of architects, performance engineers, and industry specialists focused on validating, optimizing, and accelerating customer success across strategic workloads and industry ecosystems.

Your Role

- Manage a team of remote employees and subcontractors to benchmark SAP HANA and other SAP software components on bare-metal servers. Virtualize similar configurations on Nutanix AHV using the same hardware to identify and improve performance differences between virtualization and bare metal.
- Deploy and troubleshoot various SAP HANA configurations, and establish and document the Nutanix best practices for this workload.
- Identify new strategies and configurations to improve SAP HANA performance on new software versions and denser hardware specifications that expose performance issues in the platform software.
- Work with core engineering teams to troubleshoot performance issues impacting SAP HANA and determine root causes that can be corrected through code changes.
- Deploy new hardware infrastructure in the SAP Linux lab in Walldorf, Germany, and manage infrastructure dependencies.
- Build strong relationships at SAP Headquarters in Walldorf, Germany to gain support from key stakeholders.
- Align Nutanix strategic outcomes with SAP strategic outcomes and influence SAP stakeholders to support Nutanix goals.
- Guide teams in using SAP HANA test harness tools, including SAP validation and certification suites. Serve as a subject matter expert to support performance teams in qualifying and certifying our solution.
- Analyze results from SAP validation and certification suites, compare them to SAP's KPI thresholds, diagnose failures, and drive issues to root cause across the full stack.
- Provision, configure, and troubleshoot SAP HANA parameters, SLES/RHEL for SAP tuning, vCPU/NUMA topology, kernel scheduling, general storage topologies, virtual storage controllers, and network fabrics.
- Experience with automating hardware and software deployments, infrastructure as code, and APIs.
- Ability to explore how AI can be used to automate processes further using advanced AI models.
- Understand the impact of new CPU and memory innovations on SAP HANA workloads and how Nutanix AHV and AOS must evolve to achieve performance benchmarks close to bare metal.
- Understand both scale-up and scale-out HANA and other key architectures of the SAP HANA database.
- Assist in producing written artifacts including SAP Notes, best practice guides, test plans, and KPI result packages for SAP submissions.
- Develop sizing guidelines, configuration recommendations, and reference architectures for SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV/AOS.
- Help customers and Nutanix sellers on large deals involving SAP HANA.
- Work with hardware OEMs to enable them to achieve their own hardware validations for SAP HANA with Nutanix.
- Assist with Nutanix support escalations.

What You Will Bring

- 5+ years in SAP HANA infrastructure or general database performance engineering, with at least 2 years focused on virtualized HANA.
- Deep Linux OS experience
- Experience with Nutanix HCI
- Performance monitoring tools
- Hands-on experience running SAP HANA test harness validation and certification suites, interpreting KPI results, especially storage latency and throughput tests, and understanding the reasons for test failures.
- Working knowledge of SAP HANA, the SAP HANA hardware directory, and, ideally, SAP's certification requirements for HCI and virtualized deployments.
- Strong Linux performance skills on SLES for SAP or RHEL for SAP, including hugepages, C-states and power governors, NUMA topology, SNC2, I/O schedulers, and the standard observability toolkit (perf, sar, iostat, blktrace, numastat, ftrace).
- Practical experience with virtualization performance, including CPU pinning and NUMA alignment, vCPU-to-pCPU ratios, memory reservation, and virtual storage and network path behavior.
- Nutanix AHV/AOS experience is strongly preferred. ESXi or KVM experience will be considered if the candidate can demonstrate relevant expertise.
- Comfortable with distributed storage concepts, including replication factor, data locality, write path and oplog behavior, and understanding latency percentiles.
- Scripting for automation and analysis (Python, Bash) and familiarity with Ansible or Terraform for repeatable lab builds.
- Excellent communication skills in both English and German, with the ability to engage meaningfully with customers.

Great to have

- Direct involvement in prior SAP HANA hardware, HCI, or cloud certification submissions.
- Experience with SAP HANA System Replication, scale-out landscapes, and HA/DR validation under fault injection.
- Familiarity with SAP application-layer benchmarking (SD benchmark, BW/4HANA or S/4HANA workload profiles) in addition to infrastructure KPIs.
- Nutanix certification (NCP/NCM) or SAP HANA Technology certification.

Testability Engineer Eurodrone (d/f/m)

Testability as a discipline of RAMT, is the design effort to ensure that a system's condition and faults can be detected and isolated with minimal effort and time. It focuses on maximizing observability through sensors and interfaces and enhancing diagnostic capability through Built-In Test Equipment (BITE).

The mission of Testability is to maximize the visibility and transparency of a system's internal state through intentional design. This is achieved by integrating diagnostic functions, sensors and standardized interfaces to ensure that fault identification, isolation and verification are performed with maximum speed, precision and cost-efficiency. The overall target is minimizing MTTR and diagnostic costs.

jobs.occupation: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: •    Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.
As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
